steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the refrigerator before servicing electrical parts. For voltage checks on powered circuits, use appropriate PPE and one-hand test technique.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Unplug the appliance before replacing or repairing electrical parts.

steps.title: Apply power for voltage test
steps.body: Restore power. Allow control to stabilize. Measure sensor voltage at MAIN PCB with harness connected.

steps.title: Sensor voltage
steps.body: Measure voltage CN78 8 ↔ CN78-12 — 4.5 V warm → 1.0 V cold per OEM table.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Measure voltage CN78 8 ↔ CN78-12 — 4.5 V warm → 1.0 V cold per OEM table.

steps.body: Measure voltage CN20 10 ↔ 12 — 4.5 V warm → 1.0 V cold per OEM table. LED-panel RS28T5B models may use CN20 2 ↔ 4 instead.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Measure voltage CN20 10 ↔ 12 — 4.5 V warm → 1.0 V cold per OEM table. LED-panel RS28T5B models may use CN20 2 ↔ 4 instead.

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the refrigerator before servicing electrical parts. For voltage checks on powered circuits, use appropriate PPE and one-hand test technique.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Unplug the appliance before the changing or repairing the electric parts.

steps.title: 52Er active
steps.body: 52Er displayed on panel. Verify harness seating and moisture before condemning PCBs.
steps.sourceExcerpt: 52Er displayed on panel. Verify harness seating and moisture before condemning PCBs.

steps.title: Verify harness
steps.body: Inspect door-hinge harness, ribbon/LVDS, and connector pins for damage or moisture.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Inspect door-hinge harness, ribbon/LVDS, and connector pins for damage or moisture.

steps.title: 52Er cleared
steps.body: After harness repair and power cycle, is 52Er cleared?
